ontology_decisions.decision: D01 KEEP merchant accelerators and custom ASICs separate
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Merchant programmable platforms versus customer-specified compute designs
ontology_decisions.persistence: Product/business architecture, not a one-quarter label
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Dated products/shipments; separate roadmap from current product
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: AMD and Broadcom are inspected examples; illustrative, not an admitted cohort
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Design cycle, customer concentration and pricing may differ
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Preserve gpu_merchant_accelerators and custom_asic_silicon; no duplicate “AI chip” node
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Merge only if scoped evidence and cohorts cannot distinguish roles; never infer pure AI segment share

ontology_decisions.decision: D02 DEFER CPU admission; scope/parent decision first
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Host CPU platform economics differ from accelerators; general CPU refresh is broader than AI
ontology_decisions.persistence: Persistent CPU role; the current rally is not its definition
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Qualifying AI/HPC product/deployment fact required for a narrow child; general server data cannot be relabeled
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: AMD/Intel server platforms; Arm role changes require dates and security admission
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Server CPU demand, licensing and accelerator demand can diverge; untested
ontology_decisions.named_consumer: F04; semiconductor vertical; future state experiment
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Preferred general server_cpu_platforms requires explicit canonical compute-parent/scope review; only a genuinely narrow AI/HPC host-CPU candidate can fit current ai_semiconductors
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject narrow child if evidence only says “AI capable,” generic server refresh, or PC/client CPU; reject entire data-center revenue attribution

ontology_decisions.mechanism: Memory die/stack product versus multi-die packaging/interposer integration service
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Manufacturer versus packager evidence at filing/product date
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Micron and SK hynix for memory; TSMC for packaging; no automatic cross-market price readiness
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Memory pricing/yields can differ from packaging capacity/qualification
ontology_decisions.named_consumer: F04; semiconductor vertical; ThemeState only with sufficient cohort
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Prospective hbm_memory and advanced_packaging_services; preserve old ID history; countersign shared slice migration
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Defer if owner cannot disentangle source identities or public HBM cohort is too thin; do not pad it with GPU customers/packagers

ontology_decisions.decision: D04 SPLIT/ADD REVIEW optical versus switching interconnect
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Optical transmit/receive/laser components versus switching/NIC/connectivity silicon
ontology_decisions.persistence: Stable physical roles; speeds and CPO packaging modes are facets
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Dated production products; roadmap evidence separately labeled
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Broadcom, Coherent, Lumentum inspected; mixed businesses and overlapping issuers
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Component cycles and constraints may differ; common AI capex exposure can dominate
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Review exact ai_interconnect_silicon scope before adding optical_interconnect_components; no silent narrowing of old ID
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject if only a technology generation or vendor label distinguishes cohorts; no independent basket if same names dominate

ontology_decisions.decision: D05 KEEP nand_enterprise_storage; REFUSE mechanical NAND/SSD split
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Nonvolatile memory and storage devices are related; SSD includes NAND, controller and firmware
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Product/segment facts, not company name or parent proxy
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Micron source supports multiple products but not pure theme share
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Device integration could matter, but not demonstrated here
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Keep V1; separate systems/software role only after actual mixed-substrate evidence
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Do not invent NAND-chip versus SSD independent populations merely because the components differ

ontology_decisions.mechanism: Voltage conversion versus switching, isolation and protection
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Product and installed-use evidence; distinguish data-center from broad utility exposure
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Incumbent equipment suppliers exist, but a split house cohort was not audited here
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Lead times, manufacturing capacity and service mix may differ
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Keep hv_transformers_switchgear now; candidate product distinction without new owner
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject split if parent cohort simply duplicated; “AI power demand” alone cannot attribute all grid sales

ontology_decisions.mechanism: Mining, conversion, enrichment and fabrication have different inputs/capacity
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Operating stage, plant and contract dates
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Cameco conversion inspected; public-stage cohorts can be thin or mixed
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Contract and commodity sensitivities plausibly differ
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Keep V1; use stage/commodity relations first; no arbitrary four-child expansion
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Refuse a stage basket made from unrelated nuclear names or private producers without public-security support

ontology_decisions.decision: D08 MERGE/RECLASSIFY REVIEW collaborative versus industrial arms
ontology_decisions.mechanism: “Collaborative” can describe integrated operation, not a disjoint robot production mechanism
ontology_decisions.persistence: Robot arms persist; application mode crosscuts them
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Product plus application/system evidence, not marketing adjective
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Overlapping robot vendors; no distinct house cohort proven
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Independence is weak if shared suppliers and demand
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Keep frozen IDs until adjudication; prefer one robot-arm mechanism plus application facet if overlap persists
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject merge if owner demonstrates different durable economics and dated public cohorts; reject assumption that all industrial arms cannot be collaborative

ontology_decisions.decision: D09 MERGE-AS-MEASUREMENT / FACET REVIEW oral route and cardiorenal indications
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Route and indication may change demand for the same molecule/product
ontology_decisions.persistence: Therapeutic mechanism persists; approvals/route are separate dimensions
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Approval/clinical/product dates; precommercial evidence not revenue
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Same issuers can recur across therapy, oral formulation and indication
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Distinct catalyst behavior possible; independence cannot be presumed
ontology_decisions.named_consumer: F04; health vertical and catalyst owner
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Keep current structure pending owner ruling; do not issue three duplicated state factors; move detail to product/catalyst facet if no distinct cohort
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject standalone measured cohort if merely duplicate securities/one drug; do not fabricate indication revenue

ontology_decisions.decision: D10 KEEP critical_mineral_mining_development as broad semantic context; REFUSE common economic sign
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Commodity production and development differ by mineral and stage
ontology_decisions.persistence: Persistent activities; “critical” designation/eligibility changes over time
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Mineral, stage, jurisdiction, policy and production-date evidence
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Existing house parent proxy is not an identity cohort
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Mineral prices and developers/producers need not move together
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Avoid proliferating each policy list into new micros; qualify commodity and stage
ontology_decisions.lawful_provenance: I1–I3; original project evidence required before each relationship
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Refuse uniform bottleneck, benefit or scalar exposure across all critical-mineral names

ontology_decisions.mechanism: Power conversion semiconductor roles can be distinct from AI compute
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Reviewed product/end-market facts and slice parity
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Not established by this contribution as a current admitted cohort
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: EV/industrial power demand can differ from AI silicon
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: It is not one of W-C4's 68; do not reinsert seed-only content; parent-scope and #7870 countersign first
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject admission based solely on stale seed count or generic semiconductor membership

ontology_decisions.decision: D12 OPEN CANONICAL REVIEW; DEFER enterprise_ai_workflow_software admission
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Paid enterprise workflows and application automation differ from selling silicon/power
ontology_decisions.persistence: Commercial recurring software, while “agent” naming evolves
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Shipped offering and paid use; bundle/ARR not revenue share
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: ServiceNow and Salesforce inspected; mixed products
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Subscription/usage economics may differ from infrastructure capex; untested
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: House ai_software/ai_agents nominate one scope review; do not create two synonymous themes or hide under chips
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject if ordinary software relabeled AI, no incremental cohort, or consumer only needs an existing sector view

ontology_decisions.decision: D13 OPEN CANONICAL REVIEW; DEFER digital_asset_transaction_infrastructure admission
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Exchange/custody/settlement/stablecoin services; reserve yield and fee channels separate
ontology_decisions.persistence: Services can persist across token cycles
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Licensed/operating service, revenue-category and counterparty facts at date
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Coinbase inspected; further independent issuer/cohort receipts required
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Fee volume and reserve rates differ from mining/hash economics
ontology_decisions.named_consumer: F04; Finance SectorIntelligenceWorkspace; future state research
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Start from house crypto_rails nomination; Finance52/fintech overlap adjudication before any new ID
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Refuse if no distinction from existing fintech slice, if cohort is mostly treasury/mining proxy, or rates and fee roles are conflated

ontology_decisions.decision: D14 REFUSE generic crypto as automatic economic theme
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Token inventory, mining, fee services and reserve income are different mechanisms
ontology_decisions.persistence: Shared narrative may persist; economic identity is not coherent
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Narrative membership is source-local, not economic evidence
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Public names exist, but existence alone does not make one exposure
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Common crypto beta is a trading question, not a business model
ontology_decisions.named_consumer: F04 can show separate source-local context and qualified roles
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Preserve source-local crypto and existing context-vector use; no catch-all canonical economics
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reconsider only with a precise durable mechanism and cohort; price correlation alone fails

ontology_decisions.decision: D15 OPEN CANONICAL REVIEW; DEFER retail_media_networks admission
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Monetizing shopper/commerce attention through ad services differs from merchandise margin
ontology_decisions.persistence: Commercial repeated service, not generic consumer sentiment
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Identify actual advertiser service and accounting treatment; exclude ad-fund pass-through
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Amazon and Walmart inspected; no independent house micro cohort proven
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Ad demand/yield and retail unit sales can differ; conglomerate overlap limits stock distinctness
ontology_decisions.named_consumer: F04; SectorIntelligenceWorkspace after explicit scope extension
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Missing from 18, but audit overlap with software/media vocabulary and keep retail basket as nomination only
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject if membership uses any retailer that spends on advertising, or if parent/financial data cannot isolate the mechanism

ontology_decisions.decision: D16 REFUSE blanket consumer-membership/franchise theme now; KEEP vertical roles
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Renewal/dues, royalty and owned-unit economics are distinct explainable business roles
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Costco and PLNT inspected; their different economics do not imply a shared thematic cohort
ontology_decisions.named_consumer: Existing Consumer Cyclical economic-change projector; SectorIntelligenceWorkspace
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Reuse incumbent consumer/earnings owner; consumer category remains honestly unfilled where no thematic mechanism qualifies
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reopen only for a bounded transformation mechanism plus cross-issuer cohort; empty category or consumer sector coverage fails

ontology_decisions.decision: D17 REFUSE blanket industrial reshoring; use qualified pathways
ontology_decisions.mechanism: Geography/policy shifts affect demand, input cost, labor, capacity and timing differently
ontology_decisions.persistence: Long-lived policy/capacity cycle possible; one direction is not assured
ontology_decisions.pit_membership: Site, project, award, construction, operation and orders have distinct dates
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Suppliers/beneficiaries possible, but no vetted standalone house cohort here
ontology_decisions.sibling_distinctness_hypothesis: Winners, delayed projects and input-cost losers may coexist
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Factory automation already overlaps robotics; semicap/grid/materials remain existing themes; policy/site facts are relationships
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reject generic domestic listing, political slogan, or capex announcement as realized revenue; only reopen for nonduplicative recurring mechanism

ontology_decisions.decision: D18 REFUSE fourth universal tier for generation/site/route/role
ontology_decisions.mechanism: These are orthogonal details or instances
ontology_decisions.persistence: Detail can persist without becoming a theme
ontology_decisions.public_security_substrate: Public security list cannot establish ontological depth
ontology_decisions.non_duplication: Keep three tiers; additive non-theme node-kind decision only if machine consumer proves need
ontology_decisions.falsifier: Reconsider only when repeated intrinsic thematic containment cannot be represented by existing facets/qualified relations
